decision.reason: Clock has the lowest cross-validated error, but its margin over state is small and residual lag correlation remains. Ramp reversal probes plausible-model disagreement without treating the clock advantage as established.
decision.prediction: A reproducible residual pattern at matching elapsed times across interventions would support elapsed-time dependence; otherwise ramp-reverse forecasts should track input and state.

mapping.target_relation: Current evidence does not establish an independent elapsed-time driver.
mapping.condition_to_check: Compare ramp-reverse residuals at matching elapsed times with forecasts from state-based models.
